posts.title: 2HD Guys
posts.description: I think 2HD is the sweet spot for Guy-type monsters. At 1HD you're basically just a human or elf or whatever. At 3HD you're something a bit weightier, more substantial, above baseline humanity. 2HD hits that balance of being palpably apart from "normal people" without being too far beyond them. Gnolls, lizardfolk, ghouls, they're all on that precipice. You can have the party blunder into a village
